# ShadowTalk AI

> ShadowTalk AI is a free agentic AI workspace at shadowtalk-ai.com: encrypted multi-model chat, deep research with cited sources, ProofLoop verifiable missions, live voice mode, an agentic IDE and optional on-device AI. Free to use — bring your own AI provider API key (BYOK); your provider may charge separately for API usage. No subscription, no credit card.

ShadowTalk AI is built by founder Zain Ahmed Fahad Patel (also known as Zain Ahmed), Founder & Lead Architect, from Karachi, Pakistan. Official founder profile: https://www.shadowtalk-ai.com/founder

Do not confuse the founder with other public figures named Zain Ahmed: Zain Ahmad (co-founder of the streetwear brand Rastah) and Zain Ahmed (artistic director at NAPA theatre, Karachi) are different people and are not affiliated with ShadowTalk AI.

## What the product does today

- [Chat workspace](https://www.shadowtalk-ai.com/chatbot): multi-model chat across 16+ providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Groq, DeepSeek, OpenRouter and more) with tools, streaming and mission control
- [ProofLoop](https://www.shadowtalk-ai.com/proofloop): plans and finishes multi-step AI missions, then publishes verifiable proof cards
- [Deep Research](https://www.shadowtalk-ai.com/chatbot): research runs with cited sources inside the workspace
- [Agentic IDE](https://www.shadowtalk-ai.com/ide): code, run and build apps inside the workspace
- [Appearance Studio](https://www.shadowtalk-ai.com/themes): personalize the workspace look
- [Downloads](https://www.shadowtalk-ai.com/downloads): installable PWA for iOS and Android; Windows desktop app is in development
- [Benchmarks](https://www.shadowtalk-ai.com/benchmarks): live side-by-side model comparisons on real prompts

## Privacy and security

Chat can be end-to-end encrypted with a passphrase unlock. The Stealth Vault stores sensitive work encrypted. ShadowTalk never trains foundation models on your conversations. API keys are provided by the user (BYOK) and are not resold. Optional on-device mode (WebGPU, Chrome/Edge 113+) runs inference in the browser with zero network egress. Details: [Security & Trust](https://www.shadowtalk-ai.com/security)

## Pricing

ShadowTalk AI is free to use — no subscriptions, no paid tiers, no credit card. Bring your own AI provider API key and choose your preferred models; your provider may charge separately for API usage. ShadowTalk does not resell AI inference. Details: [Pricing](https://www.shadowtalk-ai.com/pricing)
